newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan atom fuel reprocessing plant back on stream.
newsitem.headline: Japan atom fuel reprocessing plant back on stream.

text.p: Japan's Power Reactor & Nuclear Fuel Development Corp said it would restart its reprocessing plant on Tuesday following completion of regular maintenance checks.
The Tokai Reprocessing Plant, in Ibaragi prefecture north of Tokyo, was stopped on December 6 for checks, he said.
The plant, the only one of its kind operating in Japan, reprocesses about 80 to 90 tonnes of spent nuclear fuel a year.
A second reprocessing plant is under construction in northern Japan.
Japan currently relies on Britain and France to reprocess the majority of its spent nuclear fuel.
Resources-poor Japan relies on nuclear power for more than 30 percent of its energy needs.
